##### Project general facts

This exclusive collection of villas is located within a private gated community. The development offers four- to six-bedroom villas in four distinct design styles, combining contemporary architecture with a private, nature-inspired residential setting. Each home features a rooftop terrace, courtyard, and private swimming pool, with a central lagoon just a short walk away.

The community is designed around landscaped outdoor spaces and a central lagoon, creating a tranquil environment for residents. Each villa comes with landscaped gardens, a barbecue area, sunken seating, and dedicated pool and garden areas. The gated setting offers privacy while keeping residents connected to the surrounding green spaces.

The villas feature carefully selected finishes, colours, and textures, combining materials such as marble, stone, and wood veneer. Floor-to-ceiling windows bring natural light into the ensuite bedrooms, while contemporary bathrooms feature subtle lighting and a soft colour palette. Temperature control is supported by air conditioning and water heaters, alongside building materials designed to reduce heat transfer. Kitchens are equipped with a gas stove, oven, fridge, freezer, microwave, dishwasher, and wine cooler. Show kitchens feature Miele appliances, while dirty kitchens are equipped with Siemens appliances. The villas are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Located in District 11, at the heart of Mohammed Bin Rashid City, the development offers a private residential setting surrounded by green spaces. The area combines a nature-oriented environment with access to Dubai's wider urban destinations.

A central lagoon forms a key feature of the community, complementing its landscaped surroundings and outdoor spaces. The development's setting encourages residents to enjoy a more relaxed lifestyle while remaining connected to the city.

The location offers convenient access to schools, shops, and parks, as well as Downtown Dubai. This combination of everyday amenities, green surroundings, and connectivity makes the community appealing to residents seeking spacious villa living in Dubai.
